text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy was defeated in the Japanese 
Derby. Under the watchful eye of Symboli 
Kris S, she failed to become the 
protagonist. However—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Even without a hero's crown, one can still 
dream. After all, she was now standing on 
the grand stage she had longed for since 
childhood—right inside that story.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by the press, Zenno Rob Roy is 
asked about her goal and finally gives her 
answer. —"A hero."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The next target race is the "Kikuka Sho." 
A grand stage truly fit for a future hero.
